g.text: Does recent long-request context differ by historical overlap?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: Difference in request prevalence: overlap ≥50% minus overlap <50% (disjoint request groups)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: Positive: more frequent in high-overlap requests. Negative: more frequent in low-overlap requests.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: Predecessors must arrive strictly earlier and belong to another observed chain. Historical overlap uses unlimited input history.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: These are observed differences, with no independence assumption or significance test. Stratified counts are retained in analysis.json.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: A temporal association does not identify a shared queue, unfinished prefill, contention, causation, or latency.
